notes: Drink no wine: the ASV recasts the prohibitive אַל onto the object as the determiner no, which rule 15 assigns to the negative morpheme, a jussive אַל being read on the same terms as לֹא.
strong drink is headed on strong by rule 31's subtraction; the class-noun reading heading on drink is named in the unit's note.
The two waws of the coordinated prohibition each take a written nor under rule 14; no correlative pair is involved, since no is already the אַל's.
